# `link` finds the agent in the same file, next to the caller, in the agents/
# folder, or by a quoted path. (from dynamic_link)

# 1. only the agents folder has it
exec metagente run boss.ag go
stdout '^from agents folder$'

# 2. next to the calling file wins (a lower case file name works too)
cp next_to.ag helper.ag
exec metagente run boss.ag go
stdout '^from next to$'

# 3. the same file wins over everything
cp boss_same_file.ag boss.ag
exec metagente run boss.ag go
stdout '^from same file$'

# 4. a quoted path is used as written
exec metagente run boss_quoted.ag go
stdout '^from quoted path$'

# check agrees with run
exec metagente check boss_quoted.ag
stdout 'No problems found'

-- boss.ag --
agent Boss
  goal "b"
  link Helper
  accepts go
  on go
    reply Helper.hi
-- agents/Helper.ag --
agent Helper
  goal "h"
  accepts hi
  on hi
    reply "from agents folder"
-- next_to.ag --
agent Helper
  goal "h"
  accepts hi
  on hi
    reply "from next to"
-- boss_same_file.ag --
agent Boss
  goal "b"
  link Helper
  accepts go
  on go
    reply Helper.hi
agent Helper
  goal "h"
  accepts hi
  on hi
    reply "from same file"
-- boss_quoted.ag --
agent Boss
  goal "b"
  link Helper from "elsewhere/x.ag"
  accepts go
  on go
    reply Helper.hi
-- elsewhere/x.ag --
agent Helper
  goal "h"
  accepts hi
  on hi
    reply "from quoted path"
